title: Microsoft earnings press release available on Investor Relations website
summary: REDMOND, Wash. — April 30, 2025 — Microsoft Corp. on Wednesday announced that fiscal year 2025 third-quarter financial results are available on its Investor Relations website. The direct link to the earnings press release is https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast. As previously announced, the company will host a conference call at 2:30 p.m. Pacific Time.
